theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M Z : Set (Euclid P)) (F : Euclid P → Euclid n) (h : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), 1 ≤ n → MeasurableSet M → CountablyRectifiable n M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[n] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → IsOpen Z → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F Z → AEMeasurable h (μHE[n].restrict M) → AEMeasurable (fun y : Euclid n => ∑' x : ↥(M ∩ Z ∩ F ⁻¹' {y}), h x) volume ∧ ∫⁻ y, (∑' x : ↥(M ∩ Z ∩ F ⁻¹' {y}), h x) ∂volume = ∫⁻ x in M ∩ Z, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ (approxTangentPlane n M x)) => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ F x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (approxTangentPlane n M x) i)) (fderiv ℝ F x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (approxTangentPlane n M x) j))))) * h x ∂μHE[n]
